name: Launch-anchored VWAP second reclaim
hypothesis: Buy the second confirmed reclaim of transaction-derived launch VWAP after a failed first attempt, with independent net demand.
spec: Setup: A launch-specific traded-cost reference may organize later participation. Entry: Buy the second confirmed reclaim of transaction-derived launch VWAP after a failed first attempt, with independent net demand. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the second reclaim base or on VWAP loss. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs transaction-derived bars or launch/migration anchors from on-chain data
